basics.name: Jihye Lee, Ph.D.
basics.title: Senior Researcher, Seoul National University
basics.tagline: Human–Technology Interaction Researcher · Social robotics, digital health, social AI, and healthy aging
basics.summary: I study how people experience emerging technologies in everyday life, with a particular focus on older adults, social connection, and well-being. My work spans social robots, digital health, and social AI, and asks how technology can meet people where they are rather than treating them as average users.

items.org: Visual Arts Institute, Seoul National University
bullets: One of three senior researchers leading the older adult–robot interaction workstream in a six-year, KRW 3.0 billion national program on multi-agent social robot systems.
Design and evaluate home-based social robots that support older adults' meaningful engagement, social connection, and autonomy.
Mentor six master's and doctoral students in study design, field research, and quantitative analysis.

items.org: AIX School, Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST)
bullets: Investigate social and cultural bias in large language models through benchmark-based evaluation across 3,349 items, testing whether models conform differently to in-group and out-group users.
Mentor seven master's and doctoral students in research design, computational analysis, and academic writing.
